release_notes:
Release v1.5.0 - 2026-11-26

📚 Documentation:
  • docs tooling: the example generator records in UTC, so a local time zone no longer changes the S3 key samples [skip release]
  • docs: archive documentation versions after release v1.4.3 [skip release]

📝 Other Changes:
  • logging: no log line in discovery or the BOM processor carries billing data or a value from a scanned resource: fixed text, counts of rows, error types or codes; the Cost Explorer message helper is named for what it reports
  • changelog and tests: the log lines carry no billing data and no value from a scanned resource; the tests of the billing line and the cost trend warnings follow [skip release]
  • logging: failing tests: no log call in discovery or the BOM processor takes a billing value, a row, a resource identifier or a per-account trend value [skip release]
  • logging: billing lines give counts, not billed amounts or service names; a failed cost estimate or targeted discovery logs the error type, not the resource or the error text
  • changelog: the billing log lines give counts, not amounts or service names; the billing line test follows [skip release]
  • logging: failing tests: no log call takes a billed amount, a Cost Explorer service name or a resource ID; the billing count lines stay [skip release]
  • logging: the log calls CodeQL named carry no value from a scanned resource and no exception text: S3 bucket regions, Pricing and CloudWatch failures, and the services without billing (a count)
  • changelog: the log lines that no longer carry a value from a scanned resource or AWS's error text [skip release]
  • logging: failing tests: the log calls CodeQL named take no value from a scanned row and no exception text (S3 bucket region, pricing, CloudWatch, services without billing) [skip release]
  • policy: sets that include each other are resolved once and at most 10 deep; patterns with adjacent or nested variable repeats are refused; SARIF messages are built from the details with no tag value; --finops-checks --template warns and goes on when the snapshot was not saved
  • v1.5.0 sign-off docs: the pattern check is stated on the CLI page (policy validate row, five languages) instead of the generated template reference; the tests follow [skip release]
  • v1.5.0 sign-off docs: the scan exit sentences (7 never 8 on a scan; 3 to 6 win) in the governance guide and the outputs page (five languages); the pattern check and its limit, the include depth; changelog lines for run_checks and trend_note; SARIF says value not allowed [skip release]
  • v1.5.0 sign-off and security re-check: failing tests: --finops-checks --template warns when the snapshot was not saved; include chains are memoised and capped; adjacent and nested variable repeats are refused; SARIF messages hold no tag value; the pages list the scan exit sentences and the pattern limit; the changelog names run_checks and trend_note [skip release]
  • policy on a scan: the summary and findings file give the scan's real exit code and print the first 10 findings unless -v; check --locked uses the default policy folder; explain shows an out-of-scope row as out of scope; the editor schema accepts policy-test
  • v1.5.0 behaviour fixes, docs: the scan prints a summary with the first 10 findings (-v prints all); on a scan summary.exit_code and the last line give the scan's exit code (en, es, fr, zh-Hans, zh-Hant); the editor schema covers policy-test; the changelog Security section follows Removed [skip release]
  • v1.5.0 behaviour fixes: failing tests: check --locked uses the default folder; on a scan the last line and summary.exit_code give the real exit code (0, 3 to 7); the scan prints a summary with the first 10 findings unless -v; explain shows an out-of-scope row as out of scope; the editor schema accepts policy-test; the pages say so [skip release]
  • policy: policy.lock covers every file a set names by path and each tag policy that required-tags reads; SARIF quotes no tag value; message placeholders take no format spec; set file loops, deep chains and deep YAML are clean errors; patterns that backtrack are refused and long values are not matched; a waiver resource needs a literal character
  • ci: the floor job also runs the v1.3.1 and v1.5.0 guard tests and the two SIGTERM tests [skip release]
  • v1.5.0 security fixes, docs: -vv stays the CI/CD advice with what debug output holds, -v for public repositories and no debug log artifact; the two example workflows write and upload no debug log; the two masking gaps that remain replace the fixed one; the Url limit and the denied classes (en, es, fr, zh-Hans, zh-Hant); the policy pages state the lock, message, pattern, waiver and set limits; changelog Security section [skip release]
